note: field glasses — binoculars; field glasses is a traditional plural noun, often used for binoculars carried outdoors.

senses.m: binoculars
senses.pat: look through field glasses · a pair of field glasses · military field glasses
ex: The guide used field glasses to spot birds across the marsh.
Hướng dẫn viên dùng ống nhòm để quan sát chim bên kia đầm lầy.
She packed a pair of field glasses for the hike.
Cô mang theo một chiếc ống nhòm cho chuyến đi bộ đường dài.

note: field marshal — the highest or one of the highest military ranks in some armies; exact rank structure varies by country.

senses.m: the highest or one of the highest military ranks in some armies
senses.pat: appoint a field marshal · a retired field marshal · field-marshal rank
ex: The field marshal reviewed the troops at the parade.
Thống chế duyệt đội quân trong buổi diễu binh.
He was promoted to field marshal late in his military career.
Ông được thăng hàm thống chế vào cuối sự nghiệp quân ngũ.

note: finger bowl — a small bowl of water provided at a meal for rinsing the fingers, traditionally after eating certain foods by hand.

senses.m: a small bowl of water provided at a meal for rinsing the fingers, traditionally after eating certain foods by hand
senses.pat: a finger bowl of warm water · provide finger bowls · dip one’s fingers in a finger bowl
ex: The waiter placed a finger bowl beside each dessert plate.
Người phục vụ đặt một chén nước rửa tay cạnh mỗi đĩa tráng miệng.
Guests used the finger bowls after eating the fruit.
Khách dùng chén nước rửa tay sau khi ăn trái cây.

note: fire trap — a building or place that is dangerously vulnerable to fire, especially because of poor exits or combustible materials; an informal, critical term.

senses.m: a building or place that is dangerously vulnerable to fire, especially because of poor exits or combustible materials
senses.pat: call a building a fire trap · escape from a fire trap · a dangerous fire trap
ex: Inspectors said the overcrowded venue was a fire trap.
Thanh tra cho biết địa điểm quá đông người đó là một nơi nguy hiểm khi có hỏa hoạn.
The old hotel had only one narrow exit and was described as a fire trap.
Khách sạn cũ chỉ có một lối thoát hẹp và bị mô tả là nơi dễ thành bẫy lửa.

note: firing line — the line from which weapons are fired; figuratively, a position where someone faces criticism, danger, or pressure.

senses.m: the line from which weapons are fired
senses.pat: stand on the firing line · be in the firing line · a firing-line position
ex: Only trained personnel may enter the firing line.
Chỉ người đã qua huấn luyện mới được vào tuyến bắn.
After the budget cuts, the director found herself in the firing line.
Sau đợt cắt giảm ngân sách, giám đốc trở thành người hứng chịu chỉ trích.

note: first degree — the lowest or most serious degree in a classification, depending on the context; in law, first-degree murder is a specific offense defined by jurisdiction.

senses.m: the lowest or most serious degree in a classification, depending on the context
senses.pat: first-degree burn · first-degree murder · graduate with first-class honors
ex: The doctor treated a first-degree burn on his hand.
Bác sĩ điều trị vết bỏng độ một trên tay anh.
The charge was reduced after the court reviewed the evidence.
Cáo buộc được giảm sau khi tòa xem xét chứng cứ.

note: first gear — the lowest gear in a vehicle, used for starting or moving slowly; figuratively, an initial or slow stage of activity.

senses.m: the lowest gear in a vehicle, used for starting or moving slowly
senses.pat: shift into first gear · start in first gear · move into first gear
ex: The driver shifted into first gear to climb the steep hill.
Tài xế chuyển sang số một để leo con dốc đứng.
The campaign is still in first gear, with planning underway.
Chiến dịch vẫn ở giai đoạn khởi động, các công việc đang được lên kế hoạch.

note: fish and chips — a British meal of battered, deep-fried fish served with chips (thick-cut fried potatoes); the dish and local accompaniments vary.

senses.m: a British meal of battered, deep-fried fish served with chips (thick-cut fried potatoes)
senses.pat: a portion of fish and chips · fish-and-chip shop · serve fish and chips
ex: We bought fish and chips from a shop by the harbor.
Chúng tôi mua cá tẩm bột chiên và khoai tây chiên ở quán gần bến cảng.
The menu offers fish and chips with mushy peas.
Thực đơn có món cá chiên khoai tây kèm đậu nghiền.

note: fish hook — a barbed or barbless hook used for catching fish; also written fishhook.

senses.m: a barbed or barbless hook used for catching fish
senses.pat: bait a fish hook · remove a fish hook · a sharp fish hook
ex: He carefully removed the fish hook from the trout.
Anh cẩn thận gỡ lưỡi câu khỏi con cá hồi.
The fishing kit included several sizes of fish hook.
Bộ đồ câu có nhiều cỡ lưỡi câu.

note: fish meal — a protein-rich animal feed made from processed fish or fish by-products; not a meal eaten as a dish.

senses.m: a protein-rich animal feed made from processed fish or fish by-products
senses.pat: fish meal in animal feed · produce fish meal · fish-meal supplement
ex: The feed contains fish meal as a source of protein.
Thức ăn chăn nuôi có bột cá làm nguồn đạm.
The report discussed sustainable sourcing for fish meal.
Báo cáo bàn về nguồn cung bột cá bền vững.

note: fishing line — the thin cord used for fishing, attached to a rod or handline; line can also mean the whole length cast into the water.

senses.m: the thin cord used for fishing, attached to a rod or handline
senses.pat: cast a fishing line · fishing-line strength · reel in the line
ex: She cast her fishing line into the river.
Cô thả dây câu xuống sông.
A knot had formed in the fishing line near the reel.
Một nút thắt hình thành trên dây câu gần máy cuốn.

note: flag day — a day designated for displaying or honoring a national or organizational flag; the date and customs differ by country. In the US, Flag Day is June 14.

senses.m: a day designated for displaying or honoring a national or organizational flag
senses.pat: celebrate/observe Flag Day · fly the flag on Flag Day · a Flag Day ceremony
ex: The school held a Flag Day assembly on June 14.
Trường tổ chức buổi lễ Ngày Quốc kỳ vào ngày 14 tháng Sáu.
Residents displayed flags outside their homes for the occasion.
Người dân treo cờ trước nhà nhân dịp này.

note: fleet street — a street in London historically associated with British newspapers and journalism; often used metonymically for the UK press.

senses.m: a street in London historically associated with British newspapers and journalism
senses.pat: Fleet Street journalists · the Fleet Street press · a Fleet Street newspaper
ex: She began her career as a reporter on Fleet Street.
Cô bắt đầu sự nghiệp phóng viên tại Fleet Street.
The phrase Fleet Street is still used for the British press.
Cụm Fleet Street vẫn được dùng để chỉ báo chí Anh.

note: flesh wound — a wound that damages soft tissue but does not penetrate deeply into a body cavity or seriously injure vital organs; often used to contrast with a more serious injury.

senses.m: a wound that damages soft tissue but does not penetrate deeply into a body cavity or seriously injure vital organs
senses.pat: suffer a flesh wound · a minor flesh wound · treat a flesh wound
ex: The soldier suffered a flesh wound in the arm.
Người lính bị thương phần mềm ở cánh tay.
Medics treated the cut as a flesh wound.
Nhân viên y tế xử lý vết cắt như một vết thương phần mềm.

note: flip over — turn something onto its other side; an object or vehicle may also overturn.

senses.m: turn something onto its other side
senses.pat: flip a pancake over · flip over a card · the car flipped over
ex: Flip the pancake over when bubbles appear.
Lật bánh kếp lại khi thấy bong bóng nổi lên.
The small boat flipped over in the rough water.
Chiếc thuyền nhỏ bị lật trong vùng nước động.

note: flip side — the opposite or reverse side of something; figuratively, the less obvious or contrasting aspect of a situation.

senses.m: the opposite or reverse side of something
senses.pat: on the flip side · the flip side of a record · see the flip side
ex: Turn the card over to read the flip side.
Lật tấm thẻ lại để đọc mặt sau.
The flip side of working from home is feeling isolated.
Mặt trái của việc làm ở nhà là cảm giác bị cô lập.

note: floor lamp — a tall lamp that stands on the floor, usually with a base and a shade.

senses.m: a tall lamp that stands on the floor, usually with a base and a shade
senses.pat: switch on a floor lamp · a reading floor lamp · place a floor lamp beside
ex: A floor lamp provided light beside the armchair.
Một chiếc đèn cây chiếu sáng cạnh ghế bành.
They chose a slim floor lamp for the living room.
Họ chọn một chiếc đèn cây thanh mảnh cho phòng khách.

note: flower bed — an area of soil in a garden where flowers are grown; often edged or raised.

senses.m: an area of soil in a garden where flowers are grown
senses.pat: plant flowers in a flower bed · a raised flower bed · weed the flower bed
ex: They planted tulips in the flower bed by the path.
Họ trồng tulip trong bồn hoa cạnh lối đi.
The gardener removed weeds from the flower bed.
Người làm vườn nhổ cỏ khỏi luống hoa.

note: fly fishing — a fishing method using an artificial fly as bait and a specialized line and casting technique.

senses.m: a fishing method using an artificial fly as bait and a specialized line and casting technique
senses.pat: go fly fishing · fly-fishing rod · learn fly fishing
ex: They went fly fishing in the mountain stream.
Họ đi câu bằng mồi ruồi ở con suối trên núi.
Fly fishing requires a different casting technique from spin fishing.
Câu bằng mồi ruồi đòi hỏi kỹ thuật ném dây khác với câu máy quay.

note: flying fox — a large fruit bat of the genus Pteropus; in Australia and New Zealand, the term can also refer to a zip-line ride. Context determines the meaning.

senses.m: a large fruit bat of the genus Pteropus
senses.pat: a colony of flying foxes · a flying fox roost · ride a flying fox
ex: A flying fox hung upside down in the tree canopy.
Một con dơi cáo treo ngược trên tán cây.
The adventure park has a long flying-fox zip line.
Công viên mạo hiểm có đường trượt zipline dài.
